## Summary
Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Benchmark update
- [ ] Security or privacy improvement
- [ ] Feature or refactor
- [ ] CI / maintainer workflow

## Validation
- [ ] Tests pass locally
- [ ] Benchmark Quality passes
- [ ] Release Readiness passes
- [ ] Dependency Review passes
- [ ] New or changed benchmark cases are synthetic, independently created, properly licensed, or otherwise public-safe

## Security and data-safety review
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, identifiable farmer data, private farm coordinates, confidential FPO records, or restricted third-party material are included
- [ ] High-risk agriculture guidance still routes to review where appropriate
- [ ] Unsupported or uncertain evaluation paths fail closed to review

## Notes for reviewers
List any design decisions, trade-offs, or areas that need particular attention.
